name: Claim Ledger
user: Editorial reviewer preparing short publication claims
bottleneck: Finding approved supporting sources and catching unsupported numeric promises before publication
AI: Local MiniLM semantic retrieval from claims to user-supplied approved source excerpts
reviewedOutput: Every claim starts held; humans select sources, record verification, approve support or exclude; complete publication register export

comparedEarlierApps.Coverage Desk: Readiness requirement coverage versus publication-claim verification, default holds and numeric evidence gates; no claim that retrieval establishes truth.
comparedEarlierApps.Rewrite Guard: Checks original/revision pairs; this app retrieves among a separate many-source corpus, maintains claim-to-evidence links and verification notes.
comparedEarlierApps.Brief Quarry: Selects excerpts for a word budget; this app preserves every claim and source, no summary generation or excerpt optimization.
